saw_lines: Pet owners buy food by life stage and reorder the same bag, while garden buyers only shop when the season calls for it.
So the sale is won in the first line, when a buyer who needs food or a plant decides to keep reading.
Your 11 of 24 copy ads open on the zoo highlights line, so test three new angles such as pet food, aquarium starters and balcony plants.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: 11 of your 24 copy ads open on the same zoo highlights line, so they compete for the same buyers. Test three new angles, such as pet food, aquarium starters and balcony plants, each against the zoo line.
One exact copy runs in 11 of your 24 ads, so repeat viewers read the same words again and tune out. Keep the copy but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative so every repeat view feels new.
None of your 25 live ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing to check. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.
None of your 24 ads carries an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Add a first order offer or a bundle, such as a pet food starter pack, and name it in line one of three new ads.
